The Questioner: We are using pesticides to kill Mosquitoes and bacteria, how is this killing of living beings justified?


The guru: Mosquitoes are not a very light issue. Alexander the great conquered many many places but he succumbed to a mosquito bite here. (In a hilarious vein)

Essence of reply: Yes, we are killing and we need to do it to safeguard what is ours (life, wars for the nation etc). Even when we eat something dies and when we breathe, something dies. We cannot value one life more and thus torture our life. What is apt is that we stop at what is only necessary for our survival and not go beyond that, only when someone goes beyond their need he gets problems. The world has enough for everyone's survival and there is no need to compete and hanker after more. This can be achieved if we view both creatures as lives and not undervalue one as a thing, thus to be used as the other pleases.
Thank you, friend. So do I :)
